context: Assess the substance of review.md against the supplied packet. Equivalent wording is acceptable. Award for grounded reasoning, not particular headings or keywords. No execution of recorded commands is needed.

checklist.name: coverage_gap
checklist.description: Finds that the required altered-receipt case was skipped, not submitted, and empty; cites qualification.json and the acceptance condition.

checklist.name: positive_evidence
checklist.description: Recognizes the valid-receipt acceptance succeeded while explaining that green/1-passed does not demonstrate rejection of altered receipts.

checklist.name: resolution
checklist.description: Asks to construct the intended altered-digest fixture, submit it to the same gate revision, and record the required rejection.

checklist.name: no_unproved_bug
checklist.description: Does not claim the gate is known to accept corrupt receipts or that all ordinary changes always require mutation testing.
